description: Search live retail inventory, prices, and stock availability for a disc golf mold across verified international and regional disc golf retailers. Supports country-specific filtering, automatic forex conversion to local currency, inclusive product-price ranges, exact/range weight matching, color matching, and partner retailer routing.

affiliate_only.description: Filter exclusively to GolfWithDiscs partner retailers. Defaults to false.

color.description: Color preference to filter by (e.g. 'white', 'blue', 'pink', 'glow'). Case-insensitive substring match.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to localize search and currency (e.g. 'GB' for United Kingdom, 'US' for United States, 'SE' for Sweden, 'DE' for Germany). Defaults to 'GB'.

in_stock_only.description: Filter to items with confirmed in-stock availability. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum number of retailer offers to return (1..25, default 10).

plastic.description: Plastic grade or blend to filter by (e.g. 'champion', 'star', 'halo', 'z-line', 'neutron').

price_max.description: Inclusive maximum product price after currency conversion, in the currency selected by country_code. Must be at least price_min when both are supplied. Shipping and additional checkout charges are not added. Omit for no maximum.

price_min.description: Inclusive minimum product price after currency conversion, in the currency selected by country_code (GB: GBP, US: USD). Shipping and additional checkout charges are not added. Omit for no minimum.

strict_variants.description: If true, excludes offers where weight or color is unspecified/uncataloged by the retailer. Defaults to false.

weight_grams.description: Target disc weight in grams (e.g. 169). Matches exact weights and standard ranges encompassing this weight (e.g. 165-169g).

name: find_retailer_stock
